signal_catalog.name: Trend pullback
signal_catalog.rule: Price retests EMA20 while EMA20/50 and momentum agree, then closes back with the trend.
signal_catalog.use: Prefer an orderly pullback within a trend; confirm through the rejection candle.
signal_catalog.trap: A close through the pullback extreme invalidates the idea; avoid buying an extended impulse.

signal_catalog.name: 20-bar range breakout
signal_catalog.rule: A completed close clears the prior 20-bar high or low by 0.10 ATR.
signal_catalog.use: Look for acceptance outside the range; a later retest can offer a better entry.
signal_catalog.trap: A wick outside the range is not a close breakout. A fast return inside can trap breakout traders.

signal_catalog.name: Breakout retest
signal_catalog.rule: Within eight bars of a range breakout, price revisits the original boundary and closes back on the breakout side.
signal_catalog.use: Use the retest extreme for invalidation and the frozen boundary to judge acceptance.
signal_catalog.trap: Repeated closes back inside the old range weaken the continuation case.

signal_catalog.name: Volatility squeeze release
signal_catalog.rule: Bollinger width was in the bottom fifth of its prior 60-bar history; price now closes outside the previous band.
signal_catalog.use: Compression identifies a condition; the completed breakout supplies direction.
signal_catalog.trap: A squeeze alone is not bullish or bearish. Avoid assuming every expansion continues.

signal_catalog.name: RSI momentum reclaim
signal_catalog.rule: RSI crosses 50 in the direction of the EMA20/50 trend.
signal_catalog.use: Use this as momentum confirmation near a good location, not a reason to chase price.
signal_catalog.trap: RSI and MACD describe related momentum; counting both as independent probability evidence exaggerates confidence.

signal_catalog.name: MACD momentum turn
signal_catalog.rule: MACD histogram crosses zero in the direction of the EMA20/50 trend.
signal_catalog.use: Look for price to confirm through the signal candle with room to a known objective.
signal_catalog.trap: MACD lags price and can alternate rapidly in a range.

signal_catalog.name: Engulfing at a known level
signal_catalog.rule: A candle body engulfs the previous opposite body near a prior swing or range boundary.
signal_catalog.use: The level supplies context; a subsequent close beyond the candle supplies confirmation.
signal_catalog.trap: An engulfing body in the middle of a range is not enough. Candle direction alone does not establish a reversal.

signal_catalog.name: Wick rejection at a level
signal_catalog.rule: A wick exceeds twice the body, price closes in the outer third, and a known level is nearby.
signal_catalog.use: Treat the wick as rejection evidence; wait for a later close through the signal candle.
signal_catalog.trap: A wick can be liquidity probing during a continuing trend. Never treat it as automatic reversal proof.

signal_catalog.name: Liquidity sweep and reclaim
signal_catalog.rule: Price pierces a confirmed major swing and closes back across it.
signal_catalog.use: A sweep begins a watch. CHoCH and a later higher low/lower high strengthen the case.
signal_catalog.trap: OHLCV cannot identify institutions or prove that stops caused the move.

signal_catalog.name: Confirmed RSI divergence
signal_catalog.rule: Price makes a new pivot extreme while RSI makes a weaker one; three right-hand bars confirm the pivot.
signal_catalog.use: The signal is known on the confirmation bar, not on the earlier pivot candle.
signal_catalog.trap: Divergence can persist through several trend legs. Require price confirmation and clear invalidation.

signal_catalog.name: Sweep plus RSI divergence
signal_catalog.rule: A same-direction sweep and confirmed RSI divergence both become known within eight bars of each other.
signal_catalog.use: This combines location and momentum failure. A later structure change is stronger confirmation.
signal_catalog.trap: The combination remains a reversal watch; its live probability is unvalidated.

signal_catalog.name: Major BOS / CHoCH
signal_catalog.rule: A completed close breaks a confirmed major swing with the structure engine's ATR buffer.
signal_catalog.use: BOS usually supports continuation; CHoCH is an early change warning that needs follow-through.
signal_catalog.trap: Small internal breaks and major breaks are different. A failed break is recorded separately.

signal_catalog.name: Staged structure reversal
signal_catalog.rule: A sweep is followed by CHoCH, then a higher low/lower high, then a later BOS.
signal_catalog.use: Use the new structure as the thesis and a fresh entry location as the execution decision.
signal_catalog.trap: Structural confirmation can arrive after much of a move. Skip a poor reward/risk entry.

signal_catalog.name: Price and money-flow turn
signal_catalog.rule: CMF crosses +0.05 or -0.05 while price is on the matching side of EMA20.
signal_catalog.use: Volume-weighted close location can support a price setup when source volume is available.
signal_catalog.trap: CMF is a bar-volume proxy, not signed order flow or proof of institutional buying.

signal_catalog.name: Selling-climax watch
signal_catalog.rule: A down candle spans at least 1.8 ATR, relative volume is at least 2.5, and its close is in the bottom quarter.
signal_catalog.use: Watch for a later reclaim of the entire signal candle. Heavy selling alone is not a buy signal.
signal_catalog.trap: Capitulation and the start of a further sell-off can look similar. Never enter solely because volume is high.

signal_catalog.name: Session VWAP reclaim
signal_catalog.rule: Price crosses the current session's cumulative OHLCV VWAP approximation with EMA20/50 alignment.
signal_catalog.use: Use only intraday bars from a complete session history; the session resets at 18:00 New York.
signal_catalog.trap: This is typical-price VWAP, not transaction VWAP. A missing constituent disables the session signal.

signal_catalog.name: Inside-bar breakout
signal_catalog.rule: The previous candle sits inside its mother candle, then a close breaks the mother high or low.
signal_catalog.use: The mother range describes compression; wait for a completed close and enough room to a target.
signal_catalog.trap: A break in a choppy range can fail quickly. Avoid entering after the objective has already traded.
